current_hds_integration_probe.method: Temporarily patched the imported D4 class in memory to use support 2, then ran current 課題を解く with no prior-memory examples on the 19 candidate-positive folds.

limits: The 19 positive support-2 folds are a small subset and do not establish general accuracy for all two-example tasks.
